action_recurrence_period_length_required.name: action_recurrence_period_length_required_check
action_recurrence_period_length_required.value: "action_recurrence_rules"."period_unit" IS DISTINCT FROM 'days' OR "action_recurrence_rules"."period_length" IS NOT NULL

actions_consequence_refined_check.name: actions_consequence_refined_check
actions_consequence_refined_check.value: ("actions"."consequence_refined" is null and "actions"."consequence_refined_for_stars" is null and "actions"."consequence_refined_as_of" is null) or ("actions"."consequence_refined" is not null and "actions"."consequence_refined_for_stars" is not null and "actions"."consequence_refined_as_of" is not null and "actions"."consequence_refined" between 0 and 6 and "actions"."consequence_refined_for_stars" between 1 and 5)

commitment_recurrence_interval_check.name: commitment_recurrence_interval_check
commitment_recurrence_interval_check.value:
("commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_unit"::text = 'days' AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_days" IS NOT NULL AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_days" > 0 AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_weeks" IS NULL AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."weekdays" IS NULL AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_months" IS NULL AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."month_anchor" IS NULL)
          OR
          ("commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_unit"::text = 'weeks' AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_weeks" IS NOT NULL AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_weeks" > 0 AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."weekdays" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("commitment_recurrence_rules"."weekdays") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("commitment_recurrence_rules"."weekdays") BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_days" IS NULL AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_months" IS NULL AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."month_anchor" IS NULL)
          OR
          ("commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_unit"::text = 'months' AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_days" IS NULL AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_weeks" IS NULL AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."weekdays" IS NULL AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_months" IS NOT NULL AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."interval_months" > 0 AND "commitment_recurrence_rules"."month_anchor" IS NOT NULL)

condition_definitions_commitment_check.name: condition_definitions_commitment_check
condition_definitions_commitment_check.value:
("condition_definitions"."kind"::text = 'live' AND num_nonnulls("condition_definitions"."recurrence_rule_id", "condition_definitions"."commitment_id") = 1)
        OR ("condition_definitions"."kind"::text <> 'live' AND "condition_definitions"."recurrence_rule_id" IS NULL AND "condition_definitions"."commitment_id" IS NULL)

condition_definitions_contact_address_ch.name: condition_definitions_contact_address_check
condition_definitions_contact_address_ch.value: "condition_definitions"."kind"::text = 'contact' OR ("condition_definitions"."phone" IS NULL AND "condition_definitions"."email" IS NULL)

consequence_comparisons_ranking_check.name: consequence_comparisons_ranking_check
consequence_comparisons_ranking_check.value: ("consequence_comparisons"."tie" and "consequence_comparisons"."ranking" is null) or (not "consequence_comparisons"."tie" and "consequence_comparisons"."ranking" is not null and cardinality("consequence_comparisons"."ranking") = cardinality("consequence_comparisons"."item_ids") and "consequence_comparisons"."ranking" <@ "consequence_comparisons"."item_ids" and "consequence_comparisons"."item_ids" <@ "consequence_comparisons"."ranking")

deliverables_deadline_check.name: deliverables_deadline_check
deliverables_deadline_check.value: "deliverables"."internal_deadline_at" is null or "deliverables"."external_deadline_at" is null or "deliverables"."internal_deadline_at" <= "deliverables"."external_deadline_at"

owner_credentials_live_child_idx.name: owner_credentials_live_child_idx
owner_credentials_live_child_idx.where: "owner_credentials"."parent_credential_id" IS NOT NULL AND "owner_credentials"."revoked_at" IS NULL

projects_deadline_check.name: projects_deadline_check
projects_deadline_check.value: "projects"."internal_deadline_at" is null or "projects"."external_deadline_at" is null or "projects"."internal_deadline_at" <= "projects"."external_deadline_at"

projects_consequence_refined_check.name: projects_consequence_refined_check
projects_consequence_refined_check.value: ("projects"."consequence_refined" is null and "projects"."consequence_refined_for_stars" is null and "projects"."consequence_refined_as_of" is null) or ("projects"."consequence_refined" is not null and "projects"."consequence_refined_for_stars" is not null and "projects"."consequence_refined_as_of" is not null and "projects"."consequence_refined" between 0 and 6 and "projects"."consequence_refined_for_stars" between 1 and 5)

routine_steps_anchor_check.name: routine_steps_anchor_check
routine_steps_anchor_check.value:
("routine_steps"."anchor_type" = 'commitment' AND "routine_steps"."commitment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "routine_steps"."purpose" IS NULL)
        OR ("routine_steps"."anchor_type" = 'sleep_plan' AND "routine_steps"."commitment_id" IS NULL AND "routine_steps"."purpose" IN ('bedtime','wake'))

user_preferences_recovery_window_check.name: user_preferences_recovery_window_check
user_preferences_recovery_window_check.value: ("user_preferences"."recovery_start_time" IS NULL AND "user_preferences"."recovery_end_time" IS NULL) OR ("user_preferences"."recovery_start_time" IS NOT NULL AND "user_preferences"."recovery_end_time" IS NOT NULL AND "user_preferences"."recovery_start_time" <> "user_preferences"."recovery_end_time")
